_comment: Editorial content for BPL. Every fact here is attributable — see sourceNote. No image is attached. Product list left empty: the site describes LPG uses in the market generally rather than a named product range of the company's own.
description: Burshane LPG (Pakistan) Limited is an LPG marketing company and, by its own account, the only listed company in Pakistan's LPG industry. It describes LPG in Pakistan as an alternate fuel used for domestic and commercial cooking, in vehicles, as industrial fuel and for power generation.
